Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the information retrieved by WebSurfer and incorrectly concluded that George V's birth year was 1866 instead of the correct year, 1865. This resulted from failing to adequately cross-verify authoritative sources or critically analyze the data retrieved. Although Wikipedia confirmed the correct birth year as 1865 early on (e.g., Step 6), an incorrect statement about the birth year (1866) was introduced in Step 7 and persisted in subsequent steps. The Planner should have recognized this contradiction and corrected its conclusion by prioritizing the verified information from Wikipedia, as the Royal.uk and Britannica pages were inaccessible. This mistake caused a misrepresentation of the birth year in the updated task understanding.
